verdict.rationale: Users can view and print plain copies of their entity's filings, including formation, amendments, terminations and statements of information, from free online access to over 17 million document images. A bulk-data product also exists. That gives document-by-document retrieval of one's own records, but no evidenced account-level export in open formats. The probes found no API or OpenAPI spec, and the bizfile portal sits behind a bot-management wall, so the records cannot be retrieved programmatically. Missing for 10: a single 'export all my data' function, documented open or machine-readable formats, API or programmatic export access, documentation of how bulk data applies to a filer's own records, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
